title: Persona Profile Put — payload
description: Create or replace one profile: a named, ordered projection over the holder's attribute pool. Entries reference pool attributes rather than copying them, so a fact edited once is edited everywhere it appears.

profileId.description: Omit to create; supply to replace. A producer that means to create and wants the write to be safe under retry SHOULD supply a generated id together with `expectedVersion: 0`.

name.description: The holder's name for the profile — "Work", "Gaming". Never disclosed to a verifier; it is how the holder finds it again.

entries.description: Ordered; the order is display order. An empty array is legal and means a profile that discloses nothing — useful as a starting point, and not the same as no profile at all.

credentialRefs.description: Vault identifiers of credentials associated with this profile as inventory — what this persona can prove — as distinct from the evidence relationship a credentialBacked attribute expresses. The two answer different questions and a consumer MUST NOT read one as the other.

correlation.description: Advisory correlation result for the composition as a whole, returned on the write so a builder can warn while the holder is still composing. Advisory only: the write has applied, and a maintainer MUST NOT refuse a composition on correlation grounds.

sharedAttributeCount.description: How many of this profile's entries present a value that another profile also presents. A count rather than a list; identifiers come from persona/correlation/analyze.
